messages:
Noah (People Ops): FYI we rolled a small but important clarification to the handbook today: parental/caregiver leave now explicitly mentions intermittent leave coordination with short-term disability and the order of benefit payments. Please skim the updated section and ack if you own manager approvals. Link: https://docs.redwoodinc.com/people/handbook/caregiver-leave :page_facing_up:

Priya (People Ops): We're also pushing a 12-minute microlearning for managers + anyone who signs off on leaves. Required completion window: Apr 5Apr 20. Tracking is via this tracker. Please add your teams and vendor-managed contractors if they make people decisions. Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Care-Tracker

Hannah (Eng Manager): Quick Q  do people in performance calibrations need to complete this before cycle closes? Our calibration meeting is Apr 22.

Noah (People Ops): Good catch. Please complete by Apr 20 so we have auditable acknowledgements before calibration closes. We'll include a "Compliant for cycle" flag for managers.

Alex (Finance): Will the change affect payroll/benefit deductions timing? We need to know for mid-April payroll cutoffs.

Priya (People Ops): Short answer: no change to payroll timing, but we added a note where payroll handles short-term disability coordination. Alex if you want, I can add Finance as an approver in the handbook snapshot email.

Alex (Finance): Yes please  that'd be helpful.

Marco (Recruiting): Onboarding question: for new managers in the 30-day checklist, should Recruiting mark them as "must-complete-in-14-days" in the tracker or will People Ops auto-assign?

Priya (People Ops): Recruiting should flag new managers when closing the req. We'll auto-populate an onboarding due date in the tracker but want recruiting to seed it to avoid misses. Marco I'll DM the CSV template for bulk imports.

Hannah (Eng Manager): Contractors: we have vendor leads who participate in hiring decisions. Do they need to complete the module? Some contracts forbid vendor training.

Noah (People Ops): Mandatory for W-2 employees and any contractor with decision authority. For vendor-contract restrictions, escalate to people-ops@redwood for an exception. We'll add a "vendor_exception" column and a quick flag for vendor staff to record contract constraints.

Legal-bot: Legal note: suggested wording tweak in section 2.3 around "eligible caregiver" examples. Also reminder: for EU-headcount, retain acknowledgement records for 3 years. See comment ID L-23.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks Legal-bot. I've accepted the examples and added an "EU" column and a retention flag. We'll snapshot the handbook once Legal confirms the small tweak.

Noah (People Ops): Logistics: - Managers add teams in Col B by Mar 31 - Mark contractor/vendor flags if applicable - RSVP for optional live Q&A (Apr 7 @ 10am PT, Apr 9 @ 4pm PT) in Col H - Managers + manager-facing ICs complete microlearning by Apr 20 - People Ops will export LMS completions Apr 21 and reconcile with tracker.

Hannah (Eng Manager): Can initial manager ack be a quick emoji in the sheet? I run weekly 1:1s so that is easiest. :thumbsup:

Priya (People Ops): Emoji ok for a quick ack. For audit we require a timestamped confirmation; we'll add the timestamp when we reconcile the LMS export.

Alex (Finance): Can People Ops surface a per-team completion % and a "compliant-for-calibration" boolean in the tracker? Finance needs the completion % for headcount-cost reconciliation.

Noah (People Ops): Yes  added calculated columns: "Completion %" and "Calib_Ready". We'll update after the LMS import.

Marco (Recruiting): I'll flag new manager hires going out this week. Also forwarding a short onboarding blurb to attach to offer letters so folks see the handbook link earlier.

Priya (People Ops): Thanks Marco. Small privacy reminder: do not post medical or PHI in Slack channels. Use the secure intake form linked on the handbook page for any documentation.

Legal-bot: FYI: please route any retention/record requests for EU to privacy@redwood.

Noah (People Ops): OK folks  action owners please mark tracker and complete the course. We'll send a snapshot email and a follow-up digest after reconciliation. Thanks! :pray:
